mapper.select: SELECT s.movie_id AS movieId, s.similar_code AS code, s.similar_title AS title, s.similar_img AS img, s.created_at AS createdAt FROM javbus_movie_similar s JOIN javbus_movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id WHERE m.code = #{code} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
